feature: AI SDK v7 signed tool approvals and assistant surface boundaries

flows.name: Approve an exact signed write
steps: Ask the full assistant to create a scoped test task
Proceed to the exact confirmed tool request
Open or read back the created task
Remove the scoped test record after evidence capture
flows.expectedOutcome: The signed approval executes its exact write once, the preview mutates nothing, and the created record is observable

flows.name: Deny a write
steps: Ask the full assistant to create a second scoped test task
Confirm the assistant reports the denial
flows.expectedOutcome: Denied or tampered approvals execute no write and fail visibly

flows.name: Use compact Ask Alleato read-only
steps: Open Ask Alleato from the authenticated app shell
Inspect the response and network request
flows.expectedOutcome: The compact route and conversation namespace force read-only capability, receive no action tools, and direct action work to the canonical full assistant without stalling

checks: Approval input and approve or deny actions are visible without overflow
The compact Ask panel remains a quiet read-only surface
No nested card, banner, or helper panel is added
Denial and configuration failures are explicit and recoverable

claims.description: The canonical full assistant renders a signed write approval request
Approval executes the exact intended write once
A changed signed tool input is rejected before execution
Ask Alleato cannot receive action tools it does not render
The approval secret is present across all Vercel runtime environments
Desktop and mobile approval and compact-panel review is complete
The architecture guardrail discovers split tools and rejects legacy approval APIs
